x.description: Local Cartesian center X-coordinate (Easting offset from local origin in meters)

y.description: Local Cartesian center Y-coordinate (Northing offset from local origin in meters)

length.description: Length of canopy rectangle along primary local axis

width.description: Width of canopy rectangle perpendicular to primary axis

height.description: Clearance height above ground level (underside elevation)

tilt.description: Inclination angle from horizontal (0 = flat horizontal canopy)

azimuth.description: Canopy orientation angle measured clockwise from True North

albedo.description: Shortwave reflectance fraction of canopy upper surface

emissivity.description: Thermal longwave emissivity of canopy surface
